input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for the past few hours. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again so I can send photos to my family. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that helps! What do I need to do next?
I just checked my phone, and I see a little airplane icon at the top. Does that mean something important? I’m not sure about the other things you asked—should I be looking for something else?

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode like you said. Now, I see something that says “No Signal” and “Data Disabled” at the top of my screen. What should I do next? I’m still not sure if I can send a picture message.
It looks like my phone says there’s no SIM card detected. What does that mean? Is that why I can’t send picture messages? What should I do now?

Alright, I followed your instructions and took out the SIM card, then put it back in. Now my phone shows a signal, and it says “Data Enabled,” but I still can’t send picture messages. What should I try next? This is getting a bit frustrating.

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. Is there anything else I can try? I’m starting to get a bit worried—will I lose my photos if we keep trying things?
At the top of my screen, it says “2G” next to the signal bars, and I don’t see anything about Wi-Fi Calling. Is 2G not enough for sending picture messages? What should I do now?

I changed the network setting to “4G/5G preferred,” and now my phone shows “5G” at the top with a strong signal. But I still can’t send picture messages. Is there anything else I can try? I’m really hoping we can get this working soon.
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it looks like it only has permission for “phone.” I don’t see anything about storage or SMS. Should I turn those on? How do I do that?

I turned on both the “Storage” and “SMS” permissions for my messaging app, but I still can’t send picture messages. Is there anything else we can try? I’m starting to feel a bit overwhelmed by all these steps.
